description: S45 T2 (PM5): the filtered half of policy.list. Every filter param is stated and ANDed in the one place (policy.Filter, internal/policy) AFTER the fail-closed re-decode — target in its CLI spelling, split on the first colon and rebuilt by ParseTarget. includeExpired is stated explicitly (absent would mean the same true, D6/D8: an audit view does not hide expiry). The rows now carry the additive describe and createdAt: the sentence is policy.Describe's own, printed verbatim (D9 — no surface assembles it), and createdAt is the row's written-at instant byte for byte. No `spec` crosses the list: the raw spec rides policy.get only.
